rows: Why did Protestantism correlate with capitalism?
Weber: elective affinity; calling; reinvestment ethic
Why does religion create social cohesion?
Durkheim: collective effervescence; sacred = society symbolized
Why hasn't religion died as modernization proceeded?
Supply-side (US); existential insecurity (global South); SDT not complete
High existential security (Norris/Inglehart): low need for religion-as-insurance
Why is Islamic fundamentalism growing despite modernization?
Fundamentalism IS a modern reaction — perceived threat triggers defensive intensification
Bellah: national sacred symbols/rituals providing transcendent meaning beyond any denomination
Why do strict churches grow faster?
Iannaccone: costly commitment → filters free-riders → stronger community → more attractive
How does religion function for Durkheim?
Norm clarification, solidarity, meaning, collective effervescence — independent of theological truth
